prompt: The video begins with a slow, steady walk along Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, during a cloudy sunset. The camera moves forward, capturing the sandy shore as it gently curves towards a dense line of trees on the left side, their dark silhouettes contrasting against the dimming sky. As the viewer progresses, the camera pans slightly to the right, revealing the calm ocean waves lapping softly against the shore, their surface reflecting the muted hues of the twilight. The horizon is lined with distant rocky formations, partially obscured by the fog, adding depth to the scene. The camera continues its forward motion, occasionally tilting downward to show scattered rocks and patches of seaweed on the beach. The ambient light gradually fades, casting long shadows and creating a serene atmosphere. The camera then shifts focus back to the horizon, capturing the subtle interplay of colors as the sun sets behind the clouds, painting the sky in soft gradients of purple and orange. Throughout the sequence, the camera maintains a smooth, continuous movement, providing an immersive experience of the tranquil, empty beach at dusk.
